_comment: Details for the 3D house (/house/3d), traced from the floor plans and from notes on how the house really is. Millimetres in plan coordinates, like house.json. doors: openings in walls, [x0, y0, x1, y1] along a wall (a door, an archway, or where two rooms are open to each other). glazing: floor-to-ceiling windows and glass doors in a wall (kind: window, door or sliding). floors: floor the rooms leave out. partitions: walls the rooms in house.json don't draw, [x0, y0, x1, y1]. stairs: the staircases as they are (u: up the east side, across the north, down the west side, round the core; flight: one straight run). wells: holes in a floor where stairs come up, as polygons. cellar: the garage's steps down from the hall, the stair up to the loft, and the loft.

f1._: living room onto the porch: a floor-to-ceiling window
and a wide glass door to its right, as you face the house

attic._: TLM2718: sliding glass doors onto the south terrace

floors._: floor the rooms in house.json leave out, [x, y, width, height]: a lobby on the first floor, the corridor in the attic

u._: wooden, ground floor to first floor: north up the east side, west along the north, south down the west side

flight._: straight, first floor to attic, north up the east strip of the stairwell
